title: International Conventions Protocols Their Objectives
definition: International environmental law comprises a set of multilateral agreements, treaties, and protocols designed to regulate human impact on the biosphere, manage transboundary pollution, and promote sustainable development through collective global governance.
importanceInUpsc: This topic is a perennial favorite in UPSC Prelims (Environment section) and provides the legal/institutional framework for Mains answers on Climate Change, Biodiversity, and Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of International Conventions Protocols Their Objectives.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
